name: Celery Soup I
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: celery (cut in one-half inch pieces)
ingredients.originalText: 3 cups celery (cut in one-half inch pieces)

instructions.text: Wash and scrape celery before cutting in pieces, cook in boiling water until soft, and rub through a sieve.
Scald milk with the onion, remove onion, and add milk to celery.
Bind with butter and flour cooked together.
Outer and old stalks of celery may be utilized for soups.
Serve with croûtons, crisp crackers, or pulled bread.

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Wash and scrape celery before cutting in pieces, cook in boiling water until soft, and rub through a sieve.
2. Scald milk with the onion, remove onion, and add milk to celery.
3. Bind with butter and flour cooked together.
4. Season with salt and pepper.
5. Outer and old stalks of celery may be utilized for soups.
6. Serve with croûtons, crisp crackers, or pulled bread.
originalIngredients: 3 cups celery (cut in one-half inch pieces)
